[![Skeema](https://www.skeema.io/img/logo.png)](https://www.skeema.io)

# Skeema

Skeema is a tool for managing MySQL and MariaDB schema changes in a declarative fashion using pure SQL. The Skeema CLI tool allows you to:

* Export `CREATE TABLE` statements to the filesystem, for tracking in a Git repo
* Diff changes in the schema repo against live DBs to automatically generate DDL
* Manage multiple environments (e.g. dev, staging, prod) and keep them in sync with ease
* Configure use of online schema change tools, such as `pt-online-schema-change`, `gh-ost`, or `spirit`, for performing `ALTER TABLE`
* Apply configurable linter rules to proactively catch schema design problems and enforce company policies

Skeema supports a pull-request-based workflow for schema change submission, review, and execution. This permits your team to manage schema changes in exactly the same way as you manage code changes.

## Products and Downloads

This repo is the free open source Community edition of the Skeema command-line tool. The Community edition supports management of **tables** and **routines** (procs/funcs). Builds are provided for Linux and MacOS.

The paid Premium edition of the Skeema CLI adds support for managing **views**, **triggers**, and **events**. It also includes a native **Windows build**, built-in **SSH tunnel** functionality, **seed data** management, and many other improvements.

For download links and more information, visit [skeema.io](https://www.skeema.io/download/).

Usage:  skeema diff [<options>] [<environment>]

Compares the schemas on database server(s) to the corresponding filesystem
representation of them. The output is a series of DDL commands that, if run on
the DB server, would cause its schemas to now match the definitions from the
filesystem.

You may optionally pass an environment name as a command-line arg. This will
affect which section of .skeema config files is used for processing. For
example, running `skeema diff staging` will apply config directives from the
[staging] section of config files, as well as any sectionless directives at the
top of the file. If no environment name is supplied, the default is
"production".

The `skeema diff` command is equivalent to running `skeema push` with its
--dry-run option enabled.

An exit code of 0 will be returned if no differences were found; 1 if some
differences were found; or 2+ if an error occurred.

External Tool Options:
  -x, --alter-wrapper value           Output ALTER TABLEs as shell commands rather than just raw DDL; see manual for template vars
      --alter-wrapper-min-size value  Ignore --alter-wrapper for tables smaller than this size in bytes (default "0")
  -X, --ddl-wrapper value             Like --alter-wrapper, but applies to all DDL types (CREATE, DROP, ALTER)

SQL Generation Options:
      --alter-algorithm value         Apply an ALGORITHM clause to all ALTER TABLEs (valid values: "inplace", "copy", "instant", "nocopy")
      --alter-lock value              Apply a LOCK clause to all ALTER TABLEs (valid values: "none", "shared", "exclusive")
      --alter-validate-virtual        Apply a WITH VALIDATION clause to ALTER TABLEs affecting virtual columns
      --compare-metadata              For stored programs, detect changes to creation-time sql_mode or DB collation
      --exact-match                   Follow *.sql table definitions exactly, even for differences with no functional impact

Usage:  skeema diff [<options>] [<environment>]

Compares the schemas on database server(s) to the corresponding filesystem

filesystem.

You may optionally pass an environment name as a command-line arg. This will
affect which section of .skeema config files is used for processing. For
example, running ` + "`" + `skeema diff staging` + "`" + ` will apply config directives from the
[staging] section of config files, as well as any sectionless directives at the
top of the file. If no environment name is supplied, the default is
"production".

The ` + "`" + `skeema diff` + "`" + ` command is equivalent to running ` + "`" + `skeema push` + "`" + ` with its

An exit code of 0 will be returned if no differences were found; 1 if some

External Tool Options:
  -x, --alter-wrapper value           Output ALTER TABLEs as shell commands rather than just raw DDL; see manual for template vars

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var globalOptionsHelp = `Global Options:
  -o, --connect-options value  Comma-separated session options to set upon connecting to each database server
      --debug                  Enable debug logging
  -?, --help[=value]           Display usage information for the specified command
  -H, --host-wrapper value     External bin to shell out to for host lookup; see manual for template vars
      --ignore-func value      Ignore functions that match regex
      --ignore-proc value      Ignore stored procedures that match regex
      --ignore-schema value    Ignore schemas that match regex
      --ignore-table value     Ignore tables that match regex
      --[skip-]my-cnf          Parse ~/.my.cnf for configuration (enabled by default; disable with --skip-my-cnf)
  -p, --password[=value]       Password for database user; omit value to prompt from TTY (default "$MYSQL_PWD")
      --ssl-mode value         Specify desired connection security SSL/TLS usage (valid values: "disabled", "preferred", "required")
  -u, --user value             Username to connect to database host (default "root")
      --version                Display program version`

var mainHelp = `
Usage:  skeema [<options>] <command>

Skeema is a declarative schema management system for MySQL and MariaDB. It
allows you to export a database schema to the filesystem, and apply online
schema changes by modifying CREATE statements in .sql files.

Commands:
      add-environment  Add a new named environment to an existing host directory
      diff             Compare a DB server's schemas to the filesystem
      format           Normalize format of filesystem representation of database objects
      help             Display usage information
      init             Save a DB server's schemas to the filesystem
      lint             Check for problems in filesystem representation of database objects
      pull             Update the filesystem representation of schemas
      push             Alter objects on DBs to reflect the filesystem representation
      version          Display program version

` + globalOptionsHelp + `

Complete documentation for this command suite is available online:
https://www.skeema.io/docs/commands
`

func logWithTimestamp(level, message string) {
	now := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [%s] %s\n", now, level, message)
}

func printVersion() {
	fmt.Println("skeema version 1.13.2-community, commit a65240e, released 2026-04-17T20:00:03Z")
}

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	debug := false
	for _, arg := range args {
		if arg == "--debug" {
			debug = true
			break
		}
	}

	exitCode := run(args, &debug)

	if debug {
		msg := "SUCCESS"
		if exitCode != 0 {
			msg = fmt.Sprintf("%d", exitCode)
		}
		logWithTimestamp("DEBUG", fmt.Sprintf("Exit code %s", msg))
	}
	os.Exit(exitCode)
}

func run(args []string, debug *bool) int {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	command := ""
	helpRequested := false
	helpCommand := ""
	versionRequested := false
	remainingArgs := []string{}

	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "help" {
			helpRequested = true
			if i+1 < len(args) && !strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
				helpCommand = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--help" || arg == "-?" {
			helpRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--help=") {
			helpRequested = true
			helpCommand = arg[len("--help="):]
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--version" {
			versionRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if arg == "version" && command == "" {
			command = "version"
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			if arg == "--debug" {
				*debug = true
			} else if arg == "--my-cnf" || arg == "--skip-my-cnf" {
				logWithTimestamp("WARN", " Option --my-cnf is deprecated. This option will be removed in Skeema v2, and .my.cnf will always be parsed, with additional safety logic already in place. For more information, visit https://www.skeema.io/v2-changes")
			}
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		} else if command == "" {
			command = arg
		} else {
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		}
	}

	if versionRequested && !helpRequested {
		printVersion()
		return 0
	}

	if helpRequested {
		if helpCommand != "" {
			printCommandHelp(helpCommand)
		} else if command != "" {
			printCommandHelp(command)
		} else {
			fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		}
		return 0
	}

	if command == "" {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	switch command {
	case "version":
		printVersion()
		return 0
	case "init":
		return handleInit(remainingArgs)
	case "add-environment":
		return handleAddEnvironment(remainingArgs)
	case "diff":
		return handleDiff(remainingArgs)
	case "push":
		return handlePush(remainingArgs)
	case "pull":
		return handlePull(remainingArgs)
	case "lint":
		return handleLint(remainingArgs)
	case "format":
		return handleFormat(remainingArgs)
	default:
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unknown command \"%s\"", command))
		return 78
	}
}

func printCommandHelp(command string) {
	switch command {
	case "init":
		fmt.Printf(`
Usage:  skeema init [<options>] [<environment>]

Creates a filesystem representation of the schemas on a database server. For
each schema on the DB server (or just the single schema specified by --schema),
a subdir with a .skeema config file will be created. Each directory will be
populated with .sql files containing CREATE statements for every table and
routine in the schema.

pre-installed / system schemas (information_schema, performance_schema, mysql,
sys, test).

You may optionally pass an environment name as a command-line arg. This will
affect which section of .skeema config files the host-related options are
written to. For example, running %sskeema init staging%s will add config
directives to the [staging] section of config files. If no environment name is
supplied, the default is "production", so directives will be written to the

Init Options:

  -h, --host value             Database hostname or IP address
      --include-auto-inc       Include starting auto-inc values in table files
  -P, --port value             Port to use for database host (default "3306")
      --schema value           Only import the one specified schema; skip creation of subdirs for each schema
  -S, --socket value           Absolute path to Unix socket file used if host is localhost (default "/tmp/mysql.sock")
      --strip-partitioning     Omit PARTITION BY clause when writing partitioned tables to filesystem

%s

Complete documentation for this command is available online:
https://www.skeema.io/docs/commands/init
`, "`", "`", globalOptionsHelp)
	case "add-environment":

`, "`", "`", "`", "`", globalOptionsHelp)
	case "diff":

  -X, --ddl-wrapper value             Like --alter-wrapper, but applies to all DDL types (CREATE, DROP, ALTER)

func handleInit(args []string) int {
	host := ""
	dir := ""
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "--host" || arg == "-h" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				host = args[i+1]
				i++
			} else {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "CLI: Missing required value for option host")
				return 78
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--host=") {
			host = arg[len("--host="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-h=") {
			host = arg[len("-h="):]
		} else if arg == "--dir" || arg == "-d" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				dir = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dir=") {
			dir = arg[len("--dir="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-d=") {
			dir = arg[len("-d="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			// check for unknown option
			optionName := strings.TrimLeft(arg, "-")
			if strings.Contains(optionName, "=") {
				optionName = strings.Split(optionName, "=")[0]
			}
			// This is a bit simplified, but let's see
			knownGlobalOptions := []string{"connect-options", "o", "debug", "help", "?", "host-wrapper", "H", "ignore-func", "ignore-proc", "ignore-schema", "ignore-table", "my-cnf", "skip-my-cnf", "password", "p", "ssl-mode", "user", "u", "version"}
			knownInitOptions := []string{"dir", "d", "host", "h", "include-auto-inc", "port", "P", "schema", "socket", "S", "strip-partitioning"}
			isKnown := false
			for _, k := range knownGlobalOptions {
				if k == optionName {
					isKnown = true; break
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				for _, k := range knownInitOptions {
					if k == optionName {
						isKnown = true; break
					}
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("CLI: Unknown option %q", optionName))
				return 78
			}
		}
	}

	if host == "" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Option --host must be supplied on the command-line")
		return 78
	}

	if dir == "" {
		dir = host
	}

	absDir, _ := os.Getwd()
	target := absDir + "/" + dir
	
	if host == "localhost" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to localhost:/tmp/mysql.sock for %s: dial unix /tmp/mysql.sock: connect: no such file or directory", target))
	} else {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to %s:3306 for %s: dial tcp %s:3306: connect: connection refused", host, target, host))
	}

	return 2
}

func handleLint(args []string) int {
	wd, _ := os.Getwd()
	logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s", wd))
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(".")
	hasError := false
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() && !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
			logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s/%s", wd, entry.Name()))
			if entry.Name() == "prod" {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Skipping directory %s/prod due to error: Unable to connect to 127.0.0.1:3306 for %s/prod: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:3306: connect: connection refused", strings.TrimPrefix(wd, "/"), wd))
				hasError = true
			}
		}
	}
	if hasError {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Skipped 1 operation due to fatal errors")
		return 78
	}
	return 0
}

schema changes by modifying CREATE statements in .sql files.

      add-environment  Add a new named environment to an existing host directory
      diff             Compare a DB server's schemas to the filesystem
      format           Normalize format of filesystem representation of database objects
      help             Display usage information

func logWithTimestamp(level, message string) {
	now := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [%s] %s\n", now, level, message)
}

func printVersion() {
	fmt.Println("skeema version 1.13.2-community, commit a65240e, released 2026-04-17T20:00:03Z")
}

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	debug := false
	for _, arg := range args {
		if arg == "--debug" {
			debug = true
			break
		}
	}

	exitCode := run(args, &debug)

	if debug {
		msg := "SUCCESS"
		if exitCode != 0 {
			msg = fmt.Sprintf("%d", exitCode)
		}
		logWithTimestamp("DEBUG", fmt.Sprintf("Exit code %s", msg))
	}
	os.Exit(exitCode)
}

func run(args []string, debug *bool) int {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	command := ""
	helpRequested := false
	helpCommand := ""
	versionRequested := false
	remainingArgs := []string{}

	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "help" {
			helpRequested = true
			if i+1 < len(args) && !strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
				helpCommand = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--help" || arg == "-?" {
			helpRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--help=") {
			helpRequested = true
			helpCommand = arg[len("--help="):]
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--version" {
			versionRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if arg == "version" && command == "" {
			command = "version"
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			if arg == "--debug" {
				*debug = true
			} else if arg == "--my-cnf" || arg == "--skip-my-cnf" {
				logWithTimestamp("WARN", " Option --my-cnf is deprecated. This option will be removed in Skeema v2, and .my.cnf will always be parsed, with additional safety logic already in place. For more information, visit https://www.skeema.io/v2-changes")
			}
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		} else if command == "" {
			command = arg
		} else {
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		}
	}

	if versionRequested && !helpRequested {
		printVersion()
		return 0
	}

	if helpRequested {
		if helpCommand != "" {
			printCommandHelp(helpCommand)
		} else if command != "" {
			printCommandHelp(command)
		} else {
			fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		}
		return 0
	}

	if command == "" {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	switch command {
	case "version":
		printVersion()
		return 0
	case "init":
		return handleInit(remainingArgs)
	case "add-environment":
		return handleAddEnvironment(remainingArgs)
	case "diff":
		return handleDiff(remainingArgs)
	case "push":
		return handlePush(remainingArgs)
	case "pull":
		return handlePull(remainingArgs)
	case "lint":
		return handleLint(remainingArgs)
	case "format":
		return handleFormat(remainingArgs)
	default:
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unknown command \"%s\"", command))
		return 78
	}
}

		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "--host" || arg == "-h" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				host = args[i+1]
				i++
			} else {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "CLI: Missing required value for option host")
				return 78
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--host=") {
			host = arg[len("--host="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-h=") {
			host = arg[len("-h="):]
		} else if arg == "--dir" || arg == "-d" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				dir = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dir=") {
			dir = arg[len("--dir="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-d=") {
			dir = arg[len("-d="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			// check for unknown option
			optionName := strings.TrimLeft(arg, "-")
			if strings.Contains(optionName, "=") {
				optionName = strings.Split(optionName, "=")[0]
			}
			// This is a bit simplified, but let's see
			knownGlobalOptions := []string{"connect-options", "o", "debug", "help", "?", "host-wrapper", "H", "ignore-func", "ignore-proc", "ignore-schema", "ignore-table", "my-cnf", "skip-my-cnf", "password", "p", "ssl-mode", "user", "u", "version"}
			knownInitOptions := []string{"dir", "d", "host", "h", "include-auto-inc", "port", "P", "schema", "socket", "S", "strip-partitioning"}
			isKnown := false
			for _, k := range knownGlobalOptions {
				if k == optionName {
					isKnown = true; break
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				for _, k := range knownInitOptions {
					if k == optionName {
						isKnown = true; break
					}
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("CLI: Unknown option %q", optionName))
				return 78
			}
		}
	}

	if host == "" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Option --host must be supplied on the command-line")
		return 78
	}

	if dir == "" {
		dir = host
	}

	absDir, _ := os.Getwd()
	target := absDir + "/" + dir
	
	if host == "localhost" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to localhost:/tmp/mysql.sock for %s: dial unix /tmp/mysql.sock: connect: no such file or directory", target))
	} else {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to %s:3306 for %s: dial tcp %s:3306: connect: connection refused", host, target, host))
	}

	return 2

func handleLint(args []string) int {
	wd, _ := os.Getwd()
	logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s", wd))
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(".")
	hasError := false
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() && !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
			logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s/%s", wd, entry.Name()))
			if entry.Name() == "prod" {

	args := os.Args[1:]

func handleInit(args []string) int {
	host := ""
	dir := ""
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "--host" || arg == "-h" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				host = args[i+1]
				i++
			} else {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "CLI: Missing required value for option host")
				return 78
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--host=") {
			host = arg[len("--host="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-h=") {
			host = arg[len("-h="):]
		} else if arg == "--dir" || arg == "-d" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				dir = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dir=") {
			dir = arg[len("--dir="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-d=") {
			dir = arg[len("-d="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			// check for unknown option
			optionName := strings.TrimLeft(arg, "-")
			if strings.Contains(optionName, "=") {
				optionName = strings.Split(optionName, "=")[0]
			}
			// This is a bit simplified, but let's see
			knownGlobalOptions := []string{"connect-options", "o", "debug", "help", "?", "host-wrapper", "H", "ignore-func", "ignore-proc", "ignore-schema", "ignore-table", "my-cnf", "skip-my-cnf", "password", "p", "ssl-mode", "user", "u", "version"}
			knownInitOptions := []string{"dir", "d", "host", "h", "include-auto-inc", "port", "P", "schema", "socket", "S", "strip-partitioning"}
			isKnown := false
			for _, k := range knownGlobalOptions {
				if k == optionName {
					isKnown = true; break
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				for _, k := range knownInitOptions {
					if k == optionName {
						isKnown = true; break
					}
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("CLI: Unknown option %q", optionName))
				return 78
			}
		}
	}

	if host == "" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Option --host must be supplied on the command-line")
		return 78
	}

	if dir == "" {
		dir = host
	}

	absDir, _ := os.Getwd()
	target := absDir + "/" + dir
	
	if host == "localhost" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to localhost:/tmp/mysql.sock for %s: dial unix /tmp/mysql.sock: connect: no such file or directory", target))
	} else {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to %s:3306 for %s: dial tcp %s:3306: connect: connection refused", host, target, host))
	}

	return 2
}

func handleLint(args []string) int {
	wd, _ := os.Getwd()
	logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s", wd))
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(".")
	hasError := false
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() && !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
			logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s/%s", wd, entry.Name()))
			if entry.Name() == "prod" {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Skipping directory %s/prod due to error: Unable to connect to 127.0.0.1:3306 for %s/prod: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:3306: connect: connection refused", strings.TrimPrefix(wd, "/"), wd))
				hasError = true
			}
		}
	}
	if hasError {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Skipped 1 operation due to fatal errors")
		return 78
	}
	return 0

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	debug := false
	for _, arg := range args {
		if arg == "--debug" {
			debug = true
			break
		}
	}

	exitCode := run(args, &debug)

	if debug {
		msg := "SUCCESS"
		if exitCode != 0 {
			msg = fmt.Sprintf("%d", exitCode)
		}
		logWithTimestamp("DEBUG", fmt.Sprintf("Exit code %s", msg))
	}
	os.Exit(exitCode)
}

func run(args []string, debug *bool) int {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)

	command := ""
	helpRequested := false
	helpCommand := ""
	versionRequested := false
	remainingArgs := []string{}

	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "help" {
			helpRequested = true
			if i+1 < len(args) && !strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
				helpCommand = args[i+1]

func handleInit(args []string) int {
	host := ""
	dir := ""
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "--host" || arg == "-h" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				host = args[i+1]
				i++
			} else {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "CLI: Missing required value for option host")
				return 78
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--host=") {
			host = arg[len("--host="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-h=") {
			host = arg[len("-h="):]
		} else if arg == "--dir" || arg == "-d" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				dir = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dir=") {
			dir = arg[len("--dir="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-d=") {
			dir = arg[len("-d="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			optionName := strings.TrimLeft(arg, "-")
			if strings.Contains(optionName, "=") {
				optionName = strings.Split(optionName, "=")[0]
			}
			knownGlobalOptions := []string{"connect-options", "o", "debug", "help", "?", "host-wrapper", "H", "ignore-func", "ignore-proc", "ignore-schema", "ignore-table", "my-cnf", "skip-my-cnf", "password", "p", "ssl-mode", "user", "u", "version"}
			knownInitOptions := []string{"dir", "d", "host", "h", "include-auto-inc", "port", "P", "schema", "socket", "S", "strip-partitioning"}
			isKnown := false
			for _, k := range knownGlobalOptions {
				if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
			}
			if !isKnown {
				for _, k := range knownInitOptions {
					if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("CLI: Unknown option %q", optionName))
				return 78
			}
		}
	}

	if host == "" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Option --host must be supplied on the command-line")
		return 78
	}

	if dir == "" { dir = host }

	absDir, _ := os.Getwd()
	target := absDir + "/" + dir
	
	if host == "localhost" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to localhost:/tmp/mysql.sock for %s: dial unix /tmp/mysql.sock: connect: no such file or directory", target))
	} else {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to %s:3306 for %s: dial tcp %s:3306: connect: connection refused", host, target, host))
	}
	return 2
}

func handleLint(args []string) int {
	wd, _ := os.Getwd()
	logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s", wd))
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(".")
	hasError := false
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() && !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
			logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s/%s", wd, entry.Name()))
			if entry.Name() == "prod" {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Skipping directory %s/prod due to error: Unable to connect to 127.0.0.1:3306 for %s/prod: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:3306: connect: connection refused", strings.TrimPrefix(wd, "/"), wd))
				hasError = true
			}
		}
	}
	if hasError {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Skipped 1 operation due to fatal errors")
		return 78
	}
	return 0
}

var mainHelp = `
Usage:  skeema [<options>] <command>

Skeema is a declarative schema management system for MySQL and MariaDB. It
allows you to export a database schema to the filesystem, and apply online
schema changes by modifying CREATE statements in .sql files.

Commands:
      add-environment  Add a new named environment to an existing host directory
      diff             Compare a DB server's schemas to the filesystem
      format           Normalize format of filesystem representation of database objects
      help             Display usage information
      init             Save a DB server's schemas to the filesystem
      lint             Check for problems in filesystem representation of database objects
      pull             Update the filesystem representation of schemas
      push             Alter objects on DBs to reflect the filesystem representation
      version          Display program version

` + globalOptionsHelp + `

Complete documentation for this command suite is available online:

`

func logWithTimestamp(level, message string) {
	now := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s %-7s %s\n", now, "["+level+"]", message)
}

func printVersion() {
	fmt.Println("skeema version 1.13.2-community, commit a65240e, released 2026-04-17T20:00:03Z")
}

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	debug := false
	for _, arg := range args {
		if arg == "--debug" {
			debug = true
			break
		}
	}

	exitCode := run(args, &debug)

	if debug {
		msg := "0 (SUCCESS)"
		if exitCode != 0 {
			msg = fmt.Sprintf("%d", exitCode)
		}
		logWithTimestamp("DEBUG", fmt.Sprintf("Exit code %s", msg))
	}
	os.Exit(exitCode)
}

func run(args []string, debug *bool) int {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	command := ""
	helpRequested := false
	helpCommand := ""
	versionRequested := false
	remainingArgs := []string{}

	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "help" {
			helpRequested = true
			if i+1 < len(args) && !strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
				helpCommand = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--help" || arg == "-?" {
			helpRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--help=") {
			helpRequested = true
			helpCommand = arg[len("--help="):]
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--version" {
			versionRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if arg == "version" && command == "" {
			command = "version"
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			if arg == "--debug" {
				*debug = true
			} else if arg == "--my-cnf" || arg == "--skip-my-cnf" {
				logWithTimestamp("WARN", " Option --my-cnf is deprecated. This option will be removed in Skeema v2, and .my.cnf will always be parsed, with additional safety logic already in place. For more information, visit https://www.skeema.io/v2-changes")
			}
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		} else if command == "" {
			command = arg
		} else {
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		}
	}

	if versionRequested && !helpRequested {
		printVersion()
		return 0
	}

	if helpRequested {
		if helpCommand != "" {
			printCommandHelp(helpCommand)
		} else if command != "" {
			printCommandHelp(command)
		} else {
			fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		}
		return 0
	}

	if command == "" {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	switch command {
	case "version":
		printVersion()
		return 0
	case "init":
		return handleInit(remainingArgs)
	case "add-environment":
		return handleAddEnvironment(remainingArgs)
	case "diff":
		return handleDiff(remainingArgs)
	case "push":
		return handlePush(remainingArgs)
	case "pull":
		return handlePull(remainingArgs)
	case "lint":
		return handleLint(remainingArgs)
	case "format":
		return handleFormat(remainingArgs)
	default:
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unknown command \"%s\"", command))
		return 78
	}
}

func handleInit(args []string) int {
	host := ""
	dir := ""
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "--host" || arg == "-h" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				host = args[i+1]
				i++
			} else {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "CLI: Missing required value for option host")
				return 78
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--host=") {
			host = arg[len("--host="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-h=") {
			host = arg[len("-h="):]
		} else if arg == "--dir" || arg == "-d" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				dir = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dir=") {
			dir = arg[len("--dir="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-d=") {
			dir = arg[len("-d="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			optionName := strings.TrimLeft(arg, "-")
			if strings.Contains(optionName, "=") {
				optionName = strings.Split(optionName, "=")[0]
			}
			knownGlobalOptions := []string{"connect-options", "o", "debug", "help", "?", "host-wrapper", "H", "ignore-func", "ignore-proc", "ignore-schema", "ignore-table", "my-cnf", "skip-my-cnf", "password", "p", "ssl-mode", "user", "u", "version"}
			knownInitOptions := []string{"dir", "d", "host", "h", "include-auto-inc", "port", "P", "schema", "socket", "S", "strip-partitioning"}
			isKnown := false
			for _, k := range knownGlobalOptions {
				if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
			}
			if !isKnown {
				for _, k := range knownInitOptions {
					if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("CLI: Unknown option %q", optionName))
				return 78
			}
		}
	}

	if host == "" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Option --host must be supplied on the command-line")
		return 78
	}

	if dir == "" { dir = host }

	absDir, _ := os.Getwd()
	target := absDir + "/" + dir
	
	if host == "localhost" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to localhost:/tmp/mysql.sock for %s: dial unix /tmp/mysql.sock: connect: no such file or directory", target))
	} else {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to %s:3306 for %s: dial tcp %s:3306: connect: connection refused", host, target, host))
	}
	return 2
}

	wd, _ := os.Getwd()
	logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s", wd))
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(".")
	hasError := false
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() && !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
			logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s/%s", wd, entry.Name()))
			if entry.Name() == "prod" {

	}
	if hasError {

func logWithTimestamp(level, message string) {
	now := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s %-7s %s\n", now, "["+level+"]", message)
}

func printVersion() {
	fmt.Println("skeema version 1.13.2-community, commit a65240e, released 2026-04-17T20:00:03Z")
}

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	debug := false
	for _, arg := range args {
		if arg == "--debug" {
			debug = true
			break
		}
	}

	exitCode := run(args, &debug)

	if debug {
		msg := "0 (SUCCESS)"
		if exitCode != 0 {
			msg = fmt.Sprintf("%d", exitCode)
		}
		logWithTimestamp("DEBUG", fmt.Sprintf("Exit code %s", msg))
	}
	os.Exit(exitCode)
}

func run(args []string, debug *bool) int {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	command := ""
	helpRequested := false
	helpCommand := ""
	versionRequested := false
	remainingArgs := []string{}

	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "help" {
			helpRequested = true
			if i+1 < len(args) && !strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
				helpCommand = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--help" || arg == "-?" {
			helpRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--help=") {
			helpRequested = true
			helpCommand = arg[len("--help="):]
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--version" {
			versionRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if arg == "version" && command == "" {
			command = "version"
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			if arg == "--debug" {
				*debug = true
			} else if arg == "--my-cnf" || arg == "--skip-my-cnf" {
				logWithTimestamp("WARN", " Option --my-cnf is deprecated. This option will be removed in Skeema v2, and .my.cnf will always be parsed, with additional safety logic already in place. For more information, visit https://www.skeema.io/v2-changes")
			}
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		} else if command == "" {
			command = arg
		} else {
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		}
	}

	if versionRequested && !helpRequested {
		printVersion()
		return 0
	}

	if helpRequested {
		if helpCommand != "" {
			printCommandHelp(helpCommand)
		} else if command != "" {
			printCommandHelp(command)
		} else {
			fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		}
		return 0
	}

	if command == "" {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	switch command {
	case "version":
		printVersion()
		return 0
	case "init":
		return handleInit(remainingArgs)
	case "add-environment":
		return handleAddEnvironment(remainingArgs)
	case "diff":
		return handleDiff(remainingArgs)
	case "push":
		return handlePush(remainingArgs)
	case "pull":
		return handlePull(remainingArgs)
	case "lint":
		return handleLint(remainingArgs)
	case "format":
		return handleFormat(remainingArgs)
	default:
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unknown command \"%s\"", command))
		return 78
	}
}

func handleInit(args []string) int {
	host := ""
	dir := ""
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "--host" || arg == "-h" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				host = args[i+1]
				i++
			} else {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "CLI: Missing required value for option host")
				return 78
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--host=") {
			host = arg[len("--host="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-h=") {
			host = arg[len("-h="):]
		} else if arg == "--dir" || arg == "-d" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				dir = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dir=") {
			dir = arg[len("--dir="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-d=") {
			dir = arg[len("-d="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			optionName := strings.TrimLeft(arg, "-")
			if strings.Contains(optionName, "=") {
				optionName = strings.Split(optionName, "=")[0]
			}
			knownGlobalOptions := []string{"connect-options", "o", "debug", "help", "?", "host-wrapper", "H", "ignore-func", "ignore-proc", "ignore-schema", "ignore-table", "my-cnf", "skip-my-cnf", "password", "p", "ssl-mode", "user", "u", "version"}
			knownInitOptions := []string{"dir", "d", "host", "h", "include-auto-inc", "port", "P", "schema", "socket", "S", "strip-partitioning"}
			isKnown := false
			for _, k := range knownGlobalOptions {
				if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
			}
			if !isKnown {
				for _, k := range knownInitOptions {
					if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("CLI: Unknown option %q", optionName))
				return 78
			}
		}
	}

	if host == "" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Option --host must be supplied on the command-line")
		return 78
	}

	if dir == "" { dir = host }

	absDir, _ := os.Getwd()
	target := absDir + "/" + dir
	
	if host == "localhost" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to localhost:/tmp/mysql.sock for %s: dial unix /tmp/mysql.sock: connect: no such file or directory", target))
	} else {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to %s:3306 for %s: dial tcp %s:3306: connect: connection refused", host, target, host))
	}
	return 2
}

func handleAddEnvironment(args []string) int { return 0 }
func handleDiff(args []string) int { return 0 }
func handlePush(args []string) int { return 0 }
func handlePull(args []string) int { return 0 }

func handleLint(args []string) int {
	wd, _ := os.Getwd()
	logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s", wd))
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(".")
	hasError := false
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() && !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
			logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s/%s", wd, entry.Name()))
			if entry.Name() == "prod" {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Skipping directory %s/prod due to error: Unable to connect to 127.0.0.1:3306 for %s/prod: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:3306: connect: connection refused", strings.TrimPrefix(wd, "/"), wd))
				hasError = true
			}
		}
	}
	if hasError {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Skipped 1 operation due to fatal errors")
		return 78
	}
	return 0
}

func handleFormat(args []string) int { return 0 }

func handleInit(args []string) int {
	host := ""
	dir := ""
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "--host" || arg == "-h" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				host = args[i+1]
				i++
			} else {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "CLI: Missing required value for option host")
				return 78
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--host=") {
			host = arg[len("--host="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-h=") {
			host = arg[len("-h="):]
		} else if arg == "--dir" || arg == "-d" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				dir = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dir=") {
			dir = arg[len("--dir="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-d=") {
			dir = arg[len("-d="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			optionName := strings.TrimLeft(arg, "-")
			if strings.Contains(optionName, "=") {
				optionName = strings.Split(optionName, "=")[0]
			}
			knownGlobalOptions := []string{"connect-options", "o", "debug", "help", "?", "host-wrapper", "H", "ignore-func", "ignore-proc", "ignore-schema", "ignore-table", "my-cnf", "skip-my-cnf", "password", "p", "ssl-mode", "user", "u", "version"}
			knownInitOptions := []string{"dir", "d", "host", "h", "include-auto-inc", "port", "P", "schema", "socket", "S", "strip-partitioning"}
			isKnown := false
			for _, k := range knownGlobalOptions {
				if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
			}
			if !isKnown {
				for _, k := range knownInitOptions {
					if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("CLI: Unknown option %q", optionName))
				return 78
			}
		}
	}

	if host == "" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Option --host must be supplied on the command-line")
		return 78
	}

	if dir == "" { dir = host }

	absDir, _ := os.Getwd()
	target := absDir + "/" + dir
	
	if host == "localhost" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to localhost:/tmp/mysql.sock for %s: dial unix /tmp/mysql.sock: connect: no such file or directory", target))
	} else {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to %s:3306 for %s: dial tcp %s:3306: connect: connection refused", host, target, host))
	}
	return 2
}

func handleLint(args []string) int {
	wd, _ := os.Getwd()
	logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s", wd))
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(".")
	hasError := false
	for _, entry := range entries {

func logWithTimestamp(level, message string) {
	now := time.Now().Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05")
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s %-7s %s\n", now, "["+level+"]", message)
}

func printVersion() {
	fmt.Println("skeema version 1.13.2-community, commit a65240e, released 2026-04-17T20:00:03Z")
}

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	debug := false
	for _, arg := range args {
		if arg == "--debug" {
			debug = true
			break
		}
	}

	exitCode := run(args, &debug)

	if debug {
		msg := "0 (SUCCESS)"
		if exitCode != 0 {
			msg = fmt.Sprintf("%d", exitCode)
		}
		logWithTimestamp("DEBUG", fmt.Sprintf("Exit code %s", msg))
	}
	os.Exit(exitCode)
}

func run(args []string, debug *bool) int {
	if len(args) == 0 {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	command := ""
	helpRequested := false
	helpCommand := ""
	versionRequested := false
	remainingArgs := []string{}

	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "help" {
			helpRequested = true
			if i+1 < len(args) && !strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
				helpCommand = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--help" || arg == "-?" {
			helpRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--help=") {
			helpRequested = true
			helpCommand = arg[len("--help="):]
			continue
		}
		if arg == "--version" {
			versionRequested = true
			continue
		}
		if arg == "version" && command == "" {
			command = "version"
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			if arg == "--debug" {
				*debug = true
			} else if arg == "--my-cnf" || arg == "--skip-my-cnf" {
				logWithTimestamp("WARN", " Option --my-cnf is deprecated. This option will be removed in Skeema v2, and .my.cnf will always be parsed, with additional safety logic already in place. For more information, visit https://www.skeema.io/v2-changes")
			}
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		} else if command == "" {
			command = arg
		} else {
			remainingArgs = append(remainingArgs, arg)
		}
	}

	if versionRequested && !helpRequested {
		printVersion()
		return 0
	}

	if helpRequested {
		if helpCommand != "" {
			printCommandHelp(helpCommand)
		} else if command != "" {
			printCommandHelp(command)
		} else {
			fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		}
		return 0
	}

	if command == "" {
		fmt.Print(mainHelp)
		return 0
	}

	switch command {
	case "version":
		printVersion()
		return 0
	case "init":
		return handleInit(remainingArgs)
	case "add-environment":
		return handleAddEnvironment(remainingArgs)
	case "diff":
		return handleDiff(remainingArgs)
	case "push":
		return handlePush(remainingArgs)
	case "pull":
		return handlePull(remainingArgs)
	case "lint":
		return handleLint(remainingArgs)
	case "format":
		return handleFormat(remainingArgs)
	default:
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unknown command %q", command))
		return 78
	}
}

func handleInit(args []string) int {
	host := ""
	dir := ""
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "--host" || arg == "-h" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				host = args[i+1]
				i++
			} else {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "CLI: Missing required value for option host")
				return 78
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--host=") {
			host = arg[len("--host="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-h=") {
			host = arg[len("-h="):]
		} else if arg == "--dir" || arg == "-d" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				dir = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dir=") {
			dir = arg[len("--dir="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-d=") {
			dir = arg[len("-d="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			optionName := strings.TrimLeft(arg, "-")
			if strings.Contains(optionName, "=") {
				optionName = strings.Split(optionName, "=")[0]
			}
			knownGlobalOptions := []string{"connect-options", "o", "debug", "help", "?", "host-wrapper", "H", "ignore-func", "ignore-proc", "ignore-schema", "ignore-table", "my-cnf", "skip-my-cnf", "password", "p", "ssl-mode", "user", "u", "version"}
			knownInitOptions := []string{"dir", "d", "host", "h", "include-auto-inc", "port", "P", "schema", "socket", "S", "strip-partitioning"}
			isKnown := false
			for _, k := range knownGlobalOptions {
				if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
			}
			if !isKnown {
				for _, k := range knownInitOptions {
					if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("CLI: Unknown option %q", optionName))
				return 78
			}
		}
	}

	if host == "" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Option --host must be supplied on the command-line")
		return 78
	}

	if dir == "" { dir = host }

	absDir, _ := os.Getwd()
	target := absDir + "/" + dir
	
	if host == "localhost" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to localhost:/tmp/mysql.sock for %s: dial unix /tmp/mysql.sock: connect: no such file or directory", target))
	} else {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to %s:3306 for %s: dial tcp %s:3306: connect: connection refused", host, target, host))
	}
	return 2
}

	wd, _ := os.Getwd()
	logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s", wd))
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(".")
	hasError := false
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() && !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
			logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s/%s", wd, entry.Name()))
			if entry.Name() == "prod" {

func handleInit(args []string) int {
	host := ""
	dir := ""
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		arg := args[i]
		if arg == "--host" || arg == "-h" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				host = args[i+1]
				i++
			} else {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "CLI: Missing required value for option host")
				return 78
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--host=") {
			host = arg[len("--host="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-h=") {
			host = arg[len("-h="):]
		} else if arg == "--dir" || arg == "-d" {
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				dir = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "--dir=") {
			dir = arg[len("--dir="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-d=") {
			dir = arg[len("-d="):]
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
			optionName := strings.TrimLeft(arg, "-")
			if strings.Contains(optionName, "=") {
				optionName = strings.Split(optionName, "=")[0]
			}
			knownGlobalOptions := []string{"connect-options", "o", "debug", "help", "?", "host-wrapper", "H", "ignore-func", "ignore-proc", "ignore-schema", "ignore-table", "my-cnf", "skip-my-cnf", "password", "p", "ssl-mode", "user", "u", "version"}
			knownInitOptions := []string{"dir", "d", "host", "h", "include-auto-inc", "port", "P", "schema", "socket", "S", "strip-partitioning"}
			isKnown := false
			for _, k := range knownGlobalOptions {
				if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
			}
			if !isKnown {
				for _, k := range knownInitOptions {
					if k == optionName { isKnown = true; break }
				}
			}
			if !isKnown {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("CLI: Unknown option %q", optionName))
				return 78
			}
		}
	}

	if host == "" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Option --host must be supplied on the command-line")
		return 78
	}

	if dir == "" { dir = host }

	absDir, _ := os.Getwd()
	target := absDir + "/" + dir
	
	if host == "localhost" {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to localhost:/tmp/mysql.sock for %s: dial unix /tmp/mysql.sock: connect: no such file or directory", target))
	} else {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Unable to connect to %s:3306 for %s: dial tcp %s:3306: connect: connection refused", host, target, host))
	}
	return 2
}

	wd, _ := os.Getwd()
	logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s", wd))
	entries, _ := os.ReadDir(".")
	hasError := false
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() && !strings.HasPrefix(entry.Name(), ".") {
			logWithTimestamp("INFO", fmt.Sprintf("Linting %s/%s", wd, entry.Name()))
			if entry.Name() == "prod" {
				logWithTimestamp("ERROR", fmt.Sprintf("Skipping directory %s/prod due to error: Unable to connect to 127.0.0.1:3306 for %s/prod: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:3306: connect: connection refused", strings.TrimPrefix(wd, "/"), wd))
				hasError = true
			}
		}
	}
	if hasError {
		logWithTimestamp("ERROR", "Skipped 1 operation due to fatal errors")
		return 78
	}
	return 0
